name: The Furverts
summary: An underground group of outlawed furries in Leonida; street encounters let you watch police corner one or help them escape.
body: GamesRadar+ says in-game news and social media show Leonida's governor, Mike Jimenez, banning furries before the story begins, with a headline declaring the state furry-free.
GamesRadar+ and TheGamer both describe a TV spot from an Anti-Furry Association telling citizens to report furry activity and saying licensed hunters may shoot people in fursuits on sight.

TheGamer says the underground movement calling itself The Furverts appears on the Snapmatic app and in random street encounters where police surround a furry with guns drawn and a helicopter spotlight overhead.
TheGamer says that if you only watch, the encounter ends with the police shooting the furry, and that you can instead help them escape to their hideouts.
GamesRadar+, citing CNET, says you can help a persecuted furry lose the cops, meet up with other furries and get them to a secure compound.
